name: NIST SP 800-207, Zero Trust Architecture
purpose: The definition of zero trust that the federal memos and the {{dow}} strategy both point to.
what: Seven tenets and a logical architecture: a policy engine decides every request and a policy enforcement point carries it out.

binds.line: A definition, not a mandate. It binds through the documents that cite it.

verifiedBy.line: Nothing certifies an architecture against it. Maturity models and overlays turn it into things that can be checked.

sits.line: Layer 2. It says what zero trust is; the target states sit one layer down.

verification.note: The PDF was read on 14 November 2026: section 2.1, Tenets of Zero Trust, numbers seven tenets.

terms.line: A work of the United States government. This round shows the card; the full structure follows in a later round.

related.line: The {{dow}} strategy turns the definition into pillars, capabilities and a deadline.
The CISA model turns it into maturity stages for civilian agencies.
